data.title: The hiring funnel, end to end
data.content:
# The hiring funnel, end to end

From the moment headcount is authorised to a signed contract or a closed search, with the actor who owns each step and what the candidate can see from where they stand.
data.summary: From the moment headcount is authorised to a signed contract or a closed search, with the actor who owns each step and what the candidate can see from where they stand.
data.subject: a requisition and the candidate moving through it

states.title: Requisition drafted
states.description: A manager writes the role. Level, band and requirements are decided here, usually by copying the last search for the same team.
states.visible_to_candidate: Nothing. The role does not exist publicly yet.

states.title: Headcount authorised
states.description: Finance and leadership commit budget against the requisition. Approval can lapse or be withdrawn later without the funnel noticing.

states.title: Posting live
states.description: The role is public. It may also be refreshed automatically every thirty days, which looks identical to a new opening.
states.visible_to_candidate: The posting, and whatever it states.

states.title: Application received
states.description: A record exists and is linked to the requisition. Nothing has been read.

states.title: Automated screen
states.description: Parser extraction, keyword thresholds, knockout rules and ranking. Decided in under a second.
states.visible_to_candidate: Either nothing, or a rejection within minutes.

states.title: In the recruiter queue
states.description: Waiting to be read by a person, in an inbound queue that usually holds more profiles than the week has hours.

states.title: Recruiter screen
states.description: A conversation about compensation, timeline, location and a two-minute version of the last project.
states.visible_to_candidate: The call itself, and whichever parameters the recruiter states.

states.title: Technical assessment
states.description: A live exercise, a take-home, or both, scored against a rubric the candidate does not see.
states.visible_to_candidate: The exercise, and sometimes structured feedback afterwards.

states.title: Manager and team panel
states.description: Depth, ownership and collaboration, assessed across several interviewers who may be measuring different things.

states.title: Compensation and levelling
states.description: The level the panel assigned meets the band finance approved. First time the two are compared.

states.title: Offer approval
states.description: Manager, director, finance and the talent committee sign off in sequence. Everyone the candidate met has already said yes.

states.title: Offer issued
states.description: A written offer exists. The requisition is still open until the countersignature lands.

states.title: Reference and background check
states.description: A third-party record is compared against what the candidate claimed.
states.visible_to_candidate: A request for documents, or nothing.

states.title: Hired
states.description: Contract executed both ways, start date set, onboarding triggered.

states.title: Rejected
states.description: A decision was made and communicated. What it says about the cause is a separate question entirely.
states.visible_to_candidate: A message, ranging from a rubric category to a template.

states.title: Search frozen or cancelled
states.description: Budget withdrawn or the requisition put on hold. Can happen at any point, including after an offer.
states.visible_to_candidate: If the candidate is lucky, an explanation. Often the posting simply disappears.

states.title: Lapsed without a decision
states.description: No one decided anything. The record aged past a threshold, or the posting was never taken down.
states.visible_to_candidate: Silence, then possibly a bulk rejection at two in the morning.

transitions.label: budget signed off
transitions.guard: Finance commits headcount against the requisition.

transitions.label: posting goes live
transitions.guard: An approved requisition with a written description is published.

transitions.label: application submitted
transitions.guard: The candidate applies, or answers outbound outreach.

transitions.label: rules evaluated
transitions.guard: The record is complete enough for the configured rules to run.

transitions.label: thresholds cleared
transitions.guard: Extraction score and every knockout rule pass.

transitions.label: filtered out
transitions.guard: Any knockout rule fails, or the ranking falls below the advance threshold.

transitions.label: short-listed
transitions.guard: A person reads the profile and puts it on the list.

transitions.label: aged out
transitions.guard: No review happened before the expiry threshold.

transitions.label: parameters align
transitions.guard: Expectations, timeline and location are compatible, and the profile is submitted to the team.

transitions.label: parameters do not align
transitions.guard: Compensation, level, location or availability rules the candidate out before any engineering is discussed.

transitions.label: assessment passed
transitions.guard: The score clears the rubric threshold.

transitions.label: assessment not passed
transitions.guard: The score falls short, or the review is too shallow to find what is there.

transitions.label: panel recommends hire
transitions.guard: Consensus reaches the hire threshold.

transitions.label: panel does not reach consensus
transitions.guard: A split panel under a unanimity rule defaults to no hire.

transitions.label: level and band reconcile
transitions.guard: The assigned level and the approved band overlap.

transitions.label: level and band do not reconcile
transitions.guard: Expectation sits outside the band and neither the level nor the number moves.

transitions.label: sign-off complete
transitions.guard: Every approver in the chain has cleared it.

transitions.label: headcount withdrawn
transitions.guard: Budget is pulled or a freeze is announced before the offer is issued.

transitions.label: offer accepted
transitions.guard: The candidate signs and the checks begin.

transitions.label: offer retracted
transitions.guard: A freeze reaches an outstanding offer before the countersignature.

transitions.label: checks clear
transitions.guard: No unresolved discrepancy in the third-party record.

transitions.label: discrepancy unresolved
transitions.guard: A record mismatch or an eligibility bar is not reconciled.

transitions.label: posting outlives the search
transitions.guard: Hiring stops but the listing is never withdrawn.

transitions.label: requisition reopened
transitions.guard: The search restarts, sometimes with a revised profile, sometimes as an automatic refresh.
